name: Szajk (Hungary)
description: A vertical yellow banner with two horizontal bands of blue and green at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Szajk (a blue shield with a yellow bird and a bush) within a wreath, above a scroll inscribed SZAJK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szajk arms with wreath and scroll
